description: This file defines a React functional component named ModelConfigCard, which provides a user interface for selecting and configuring model parameters such as temperature and max tokens within a UI dashboard. It includes imports for React, UI components, and icons, and manages internal state for showing/hiding configuration options. The component communicates parameter changes via callback props.

methods.name: ModelConfigCard
methods.description: React functional component for displaying and editing model configuration parameters, including model selection, temperature, and max tokens. It manages local UI state to toggle parameter display and invokes callback props on value changes.
